text: Over the last 30 days, visitors have noted issues related to food quality and wait times, each mentioned in three reviews. windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that the kitchen was frequently backed up and only grab-and-go options were offered late in the day. The quality and portion sizes of the food were criticized, especially given the high prices, with multiple comments describing sandwiches and sides as overpriced and underwhelming. While the library itself received positive remarks, the café’s menu choices, pricing, and service logistics were repeatedly identified as areas needing improvement.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service delays and long wait times were also noted, including times when the kitchen was unable to take orders for extended periods. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the café’s current offerings and operations are a frequent source of dissatisfaction. Addressing these food service challenges should be a priority.
